ModMetaData.name: Machiavelli
ModMetaData.author: T&B Modding
ModMetaData.description:
Some people don't want to hurt you. They want to own you.
Adds a trait in two strengths: Calculating (mild) and Machiavellian (full). These colonists feel everything anyone else feels. They are not cold and they are not empty. They simply treat other people as moves on a board.
Both strengths - Confide: a new interaction. They share something personal, true or not, and it binds the other person to them. - Patient. They rarely start social fights, and they are better at negotiating and reading people.
Machiavellian only - Favours owed. Rescue someone, recruit them, treat them well or confide in them, and they owe you. Holding favours lifts the mood. - Cashing in. Someone who owes a Machiavellian a favour cannot bring themselves to insult them. The favour is spent instead. - Divide and rule. When two other colonists fall out, a Machiavellian quietly enjoys it. - Useful and dead weight. They rate colonists by what they contribute, not by warmth. - Standing. Being respected lifts them. Being overlooked eats at them. - When a Machiavellian finally breaks, they don't rampage. They turn on whoever they had already written off.
Conflicts with Sociopath, Psychopath and Kind: a colonist is one thing or the other.
Settings Options → Mod settings → Machiavelli. Adjust how long a favour lasts, how often they confide, and the two standing thresholds. Cashing in, divide and rule, the usefulness rating and standing can each be switched off.
Note that switching off "useful and dead weight" also removes the targeting from their breakdowns: with nobody written off, a breakdown picks a target the ordinary way. The breakdown behaviour itself has no switches, and neither does how often the trait appears.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add to an existing save. RimWorld 1.6, no DLC needed.
